g.text: Layered defences — the holes each defect passed through
— every layer had an aligned hole
— holes closed, or deliberately left open
carries ids as bare strings, so an
edge naming a non-existent node is well-typed
or malformed input was ever constructed
React Flow silently skips an edge to a
missing node; CSS clips without reporting overflow
reject the graph — but in another
process, minutes later, naming an opaque vertex id
a threshold fault is invisible below its
threshold; six agents existed for weeks
branding them by membership is a larger refactor.
substitutes a lint rule, now enforced, that
example tests over the real broken topology,
plus property tests over generated graphs
jsdom interaction tests; jest mappings for
the repair now warns, naming the edges it
dropped: a correction the author cannot see
is the same failure as silent corruption
the error now names the neighbouring nodes
and the remedy, not a bare vertex id
fixtures must exceed any layout capacity:
the render tests use nine agents
is the one that does not:
the type system still permits an edge naming a node
that does not exist, because ids are bare strings.
Branding them by membership would close it properly;
until then the lint rule covers the site where the
